[CLARIFICATION ON KBDJUNIOR](news/news/20.html)

[Indian Kabaddi Teams for 18th Asian Games declared](news/news/19.html)

We have received an anonymous complaint levelling serious charges against madam Neelam and her husband Mr. Ajay, we cannot take any cognizance on anonymous complaints but we assure the complainant if she discloses her identity along with her signed complaint to us, not only her identity will be kept secret but, strict action will be taken in this regard.

As per the order dated 06.02.2025, passed by the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India in W.P (C) No. 93 of 2025, the charge of the Amateur Kabaddi Federation of India (AKFI) has been handed over to its newly elected governing body.
